field_descriptions.course: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.
field_descriptions.diet: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.
field_descriptions.distance: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.
field_descriptions.exercise_course: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.
field_descriptions.exercise_plan: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.
field_descriptions.exercise_related_diet: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.
field_descriptions.exercise_type: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.
field_descriptions.from_location: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.opponent: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.
field_descriptions.sports_activity_location: A sub property of location. The sports activity location where this action occurred.
field_descriptions.sports_event: A sub property of location. The sports event where this action occurred.
field_descriptions.sports_team: A sub property of participant. The sports team that participated on this action.
field_descriptions.to_location: A sub property of location. The final location of the object or the agent after the action.
